notes: A page can no longer take the whole load down by reaching for a module that is not there. Character, Movement, Visuals and World now check for their module first: the Protection section, the Waypoints section, Low graphics and the whole World page are skipped with a console line naming the file that did not load, instead of raising at build time and rolling the hub back. This is what a stale, executor-cached loader looked like from the outside - a new page against a file list that had never heard of modules/guard.lua. If you see one of those lines, run once with getgenv().AetherFresh = true.
